note: someone else's promotion is not a job post
text:
Big shoutout to my former colleague Dana. She is one of the most driven people I know.

- At Northwind she went from analyst to COO
- When she got promoted to VP she took equity instead of salary
- She lived next to the office for two years
- Investors tried to replace her and failed
- Her shares are now worth millions
- She has put everything into her next company

note: a past workshop is a report, not an event
text: Sorting piles of notes from a 2-day internal workshop with partner judges last weekend. We discussed how courts apply new guidelines in practice, and what changed since the reform. The workshop was a great reminder of how much happens behind the scenes, and how differently the same rule reads in different places.

Our special issue on entrepreneurial myths is out. We collected twelve papers that test popular claims with data, and the editorial explains which claims hold up and which do not. All articles are open access in the journal for the next three months.

note: first-person promotion is a job post
text: Some personal news: I've been promoted to Head of Data at Contoso! Grateful to my team and my manager for the trust over the last four years. Excited for the next chapter and for everything we will build together in 2027.
